**Diagnostic bundle**
In the app: Settings → Support → **Report a problem** writes
`UnifiedRGB-diagnostic-<date>.txt` to your Desktop (and opens a prefilled
issue for you). Please attach it — it
contains your hardware survey and the session log (skim it first if that
concerns you). Bug reports without it are usually unanswerable.

**Version**
Title bar shows it (e.g. v1.0.17).
